description: Researcher-made timeline graphic assembling four screenshots across May 2-16, 2018 to argue that Q posts anticipated a document-declassification push. Panels show: a May 2 Donald Trump tweet about using presidential powers over withheld documents; a May 10 Q post (No. 73) with a photo of a pen on White House-seal letterhead, filename DOJNUNESRELEASE.png; a May 15 letter from Reps. Mark Meadows, Jim Jordan, and Ron DeSantis asking Trump to instruct AG Jeff Sessions to produce documents requested by Congress; and a May 16 Q post saying 'Follow the pen' and linking a Jim Jordan tweet. Captions beneath each panel state the compiler's interpretation, including the claim that 'pen pictures' indicate upcoming executive orders.
text: May 2, 2018. Donald J. Trump @realDonaldTrump. A Rigged System - They don't want to turn over Documents to Congress. What are they afraid of? Why so much redacting? Why such unequal "justice?" At some point I will have no choice but to use the powers granted to the Presidency and get involved! 10:45 AM - 2 May 2018. DJT says that he may at some point have to use his Presidential powers to declassify info. May 10, 2018. Q !4pRcUA6BE 05/10/18 (Thu) 21:49:00 No.73. File: 4d36a72c70f9644(...).png (364.28 KB, 295x640, 59:128, DOJNUNESRELEASE.png). Q posts a picture of the pen laying on top of a paper containing the White House seal. "Pen pictures" indicate upcoming executive orders. The picture is titled, "DOJNUNESRELEASE.png". May 15, 2018. Congress of the United States, Washington, DC 20515. May 15, 2018. The Honorable Donald J. Trump, President of the United States, 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue, Washington, D.C. 20500. Dear Mr. President: We write to request that you exercise your authority as President of the United States to instruct Attorney General Jeff Sessions to immediately produce all documents requested by Congress relating to our investigation of certain prosecutorial and investigative decisions made by the Department of Justice and FBI in 2016 and 2017. In May 2017, Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein informed Congress that the Special Counsel's investigation should not impede ongoing Congressional investigations. Additionally, Mr. Rosenstein requested that Congressional efforts coordinate with the Department of Justice. In the year that has passed since these commitments were made, the Department of Justice has failed to fully comply with regular and repeated Congressional requests and subpoenas. Our power as Congress to conduct investigations is broad, inherent and mandated by the Constitution. As a separate and equal branch of government, we have a constitutional right to these documents. To complete our independent oversight and investigative duties, we must obtain all documents responsive to previous requests by Congress. This includes the documents related to potential abuses of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act; documents related to the FBI and broader Department of Justice's initial investigation into the Trump campaign prior to the appointment of the Special Counsel; and the unredacted August 2017 memo written by Deputy Attorney General Rosenstein that articulated the scope of the Special Counsel's jurisdiction. The Department of Justice has obstructed Congressional oversight by refusing to supply necessary and relevant documents. As members of the legislative branch, we believe the best course of action would be for you to exercise the powers vested in the Executive to make the documents we require available to Congress. Thank you for your attention to this matter. Sincerely, Mark Meadows Member of Congress. Jim Jordan Member of Congress. Ron DeSantis Member of Congress. Briefing by Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein regarding former FBI Director Comey's removal, May 19, 2017. See also, letter from Jason Chaffetz to Andrew McCabe, May 25, 2017, available at https://oversight.house.gov/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/2017-05-25-JEC-to-McCabe-FBI-Comey-Memoranda.pdf. Id. See e.g., Watkins v. United States, 354 U.S. 178, 187 (1956). 3 members of congress request DJT to use his powers to release the documents. May 16, 2018. Q !4pRcUA6BE 05/16/18 (Wed) 14:45:50 ID: a0f62e No.1432932. Follow the pen. Already written? Letters left visible to match. https://mobile.twitter.com/Jim_Jordan/status/996821093146120192 WWG1WGA! Q
flags: Compiler's captions assert an unverified interpretation that Q 'pen pictures' predict executive orders and that the events are causally linked
Fine-print footnote text in the letter panel is small; footnote transcription is best-effort

description: Screenshot of Q post No. 99 (tripcode !UW.yye1fxo) dated 02/16/18, reading '[UK] - Stay Alert. Q'. The post's attached image is a dark nighttime elevated view of a multi-lane city street with heavy traffic, streetlights, and pedestrians. description: Photograph taken through an aircraft window at high altitude, looking down past scattered cumulus clouds at a hazy sea with several small dark islands and a sunlit horizon band at dusk or dawn. No landmarks are identifiable. The original Q filename '_AF1_5A_3.png' implies the photo was taken aboard Air Force One; nothing in the image itself confirms the aircraft or the location.

description: Nighttime photograph of a crowded funfair with an illuminated carousel on the left, food and game stalls, and a red-and-green roller coaster with a partially readable illuminated sign (letters '...DE MA...', consistent with a 'Wilde Maus' style coaster). Crowds in winter clothing walk between the attractions. The Q filename 'CLAS_WW_UK_ACTIVE_T.png' is read by researchers as referring to Winter Wonderland in the UK (Hyde Park, London); the venue is consistent with that but not confirmed by anything visible.
places: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland (inferred from filename)
flags: Venue identified only by inference from the Q filename WW_UK; not confirmed from the image itself
